I. 3. 25-6</ls> and <ls>Vārt. 1</ls>) .²1 To stand near; fall to oneʼs share; नादत्तमुपतिष्ठति <ls>Pt. 2. 127</ls> remain; विष्टभ्य पादावुपतिष्ठते श्रीः <ls>Mu. 4. 13</ls>. .²2 To come near, approach; मामुपतिष्ठस्व <ls>Mu. 1</ls> come to me; रामं मुनिरुपस्थितः <ls>R. 15. 76</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 64</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. राजद्वारम् <ls>U. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 45</ls>, <ls n="R. 1.">87</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 39</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 15</ls>. .²3 To wait or attend upon, serve; नाटकेनोपस्थातव्यमस्माभिः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. We must wait upon (serve) (the audience) with a play; <ls>Ms. 2. 48</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 189</ls>; पुरा शकमुपस्थाय <ls>R. 1. 75</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 24</ls>; <ls>U. 1</ls>. .²4 To approach with prayers, worship (said to be <ab>Ātm.</ab> only in this sense); ये सूर्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते मन्त्रैः <ls>Bk. 8. 13</ls>; न त्र्यम्बकादन्यमुपास्थितासौ <ls n="Bk.">1. 3</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 6</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 63</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 10</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 22</ls>; <ls>Māl.</ls>; <ls>U. 2</ls>, <ls n="U.">3</ls>, <ls n="U.">7</ls>; सख्येन मामुपतिष्ठते treats me as a friend. .²5 To be or remain near, stay with. .²6 To go to with the desire of getting (<ab>P.</ab> or <ab>Ā.</ab>); प्रभुमुपतिष्ठति-ते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²7 To approach for intercourse; कं रहस्युपतिष्ठसे <ls>Bk. 5. 68</ls>; पतिमुपतिष्ठते नारी <ls>Vop.</ls> .²8 To meet, join (as a river) (<ab>Ā.</ab>); गङ्गा यमुनामुपतिष्ठते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²9 To form friendship with, make a friend of; रथिकानुपतिष्ठते <ls>Sk.</ls>; उपास्थितैवमुक्ते तं सखायं राघवः पितुः <ls>Bk. 6. 42</ls>; सन्तमुपतिष्ठते साधुः <ls>Vop.</ls> .²10 To approach with hostile intentions. .²11 To lead to, go to or reach (<ab>Ā.</ab>) (as a way); पन्थाः स्रुघ्नमुपतिष्ठते <ls>Sk.</ls> (प्राप्नोति); <ls>Ms. 3. 76</ls>. .²12 To pass over to, devolve upon, fall to the share of; मूलपुरुषावसाने संपदः परमुपतिष्ठन्ति <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>Ki. 13. 69</ls>; वीरसूरिति शब्दोऽयं तनयात्त्वामुपस्थितः <ls>M. 5. 16</ls>, applies to you; <ls>R. 8. 2</ls>; विपदुत्पत्तिमतामुपस्थिता <ls n="R.">8. 83</ls> awaits or falls to the lot of. .²13 To occur, arise; be got; अहोऽस्माकं भोजनमुपस्थितम् <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²14 To be present (<ab>Ā.</ab>); स्मृत्युपस्थितौ श्लोकौ <ls>U. 6</ls>; भोजनकाले उपतिष्ठते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²15 To stand under for support. .²16 To resort to; वेशमुपतिष्ठन्ति <ls>Dk. 60</ls>. .²17 To conciliate. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (-स्थापयति) .²1 To provide, present with, furnish with; to get ready, prepare; अस्खलितसुखसंपातं रथमुपस्थापय <ls>U. 1</ls>; सबाणासनं रथम् <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²2 To place upon or near. .²3 To produce.
